newsitem.title: CANADA: Foreign control of corporate Canada rises.
newsitem.headline: Foreign control of corporate Canada rises.

text.p: The foreign-controlled share of operating revenue in Canada rose 1.3 percentage points to 29.8 percent in 1995, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.
The near-record rise was caused by a combination of revenue growth in the foreign-controlled sector that was three times as strong as that of domestically controlled sector, and by foreign takeovers.
But it said in the case of large firms, more export-intensive, Canadians outperformed their foreign-controlled counterparts.
